tags.tree-input: the input is an lxml tree, rebuilt node by node for the replay
tags.test-file: an argument names a file of the upstream tests (settingsfile=), rebuilt for the replay
tags.unreplayable: an argument could not be stored (dropped from the recording)
tags.extractor-subclass: options= was a subclass of Extractor; replayed as a plain Extractor
tags.default-config-mutated: the tests had changed trafilatura's DEFAULT_CONFIG in place (1.11.0's set MIN_OUTPUT_SIZE and MIN_EXTRACTED_SIZE to 0 at import): the call is recorded with the config= it saw
tags.config-added: with default-config-mutated: the test passed no config=, the recording adds the one in effect
tags.pristine-config: a default-config-mutated call again with trafilatura's own DEFAULT_CONFIG (its own group)
tags.differs-from-test: the clean replay differs from what the test observed (see step 3)
